finding: The old loop visits physical moduleData CIs, but collectAxioms receives only ci.name. Its imported extension lookup chooses env.getModuleIdxFor? Name; fallback chooses env.checked.find? Name. Consequently a physically different CI with that same Name is not necessarily inspected by the root-name call.
conditional_scope: This is a potential coverage gap if same-name physical CIs have different own dependency payloads. Duplicate Names alone do not prove different bodies or nonstandard axioms, and no past gate failure is asserted.

standard_Lean_collector.import_cache_resolution: ExportedAxiomsState.find? uses env.getModuleIdxFor? c and indexed Name cache

complexity.own_payload_work: Linear traversal of each actual CI own type/value, plus NameSet insertion for distinct direct constants; shared Expr behavior follows Lean Expr.getUsedConstants.
complexity.dedup: Per-root type/value/constructor direct names unioned before transitive calls.
complexity.global_cache: Each distinct global direct callee invokes standard collectAxioms at most once; imported declarations normally use Lean precomputed axiom entries.
complexity.bound: O(total scanned physical type/value traversal + E log d + D standard cached collection); E=per-root deduplicated direct edges, d=per-root direct names, D=distinct environment callee names. No repeated whole kernel or AST export.
complexity.memory: Per-root direct NameSet, global callee-to-small-axiom-array cache, and full per-physical-root JSON result rows; no Expr DAG serialization.

execution_interface_for_publisher_after_.roster_env: HIRONAKA_PHYSICAL_CI_ROSTER=final363 complete actual source module roster path
execution_interface_for_publisher_after_.gate_scope: Final-only complete metadata/axiom gate; retain old gate logs rather than replaying old kernel/Expr cohorts.

limits: No source-only review can assert successful elaboration or actual standard-axiom results; final runtime remains pending.

Transitive Expr.const references retain ordinary global Name semantics; each Hironaka physical root is checked separately, while standard collector resolves each callee through the checked imported environment.
The new audit does not establish equality of duplicate CI type/value payloads or replace whole-Expr and kernel gates.
A failure to resolve a direct imported callee is an explicit BLOCKED diagnostic; it is never silently treated as axiom-free.
